gcp.artifactregistry.storage.note: Storage, the same for regional and multi-regional repositories (one global SKU, https://cloud.google.com/artifact-registry/pricing). Synced from the Billing Catalog. The price list's first tier is a free grant, billed here at the first paid tier's price.

gcp.artifactregistry.transfer.asia.note: Data transfer from a repository to Google Cloud in another location, between locations in Asia Pacific; the SKU is sold in every Asia Pacific region at one price, read in asia-northeast1. Within one location it is free.

filters.description: Artifact Registry Network Inter Region Egress AsiaPacfic to AsiaPacfic

gcp.artifactregistry.transfer.europe.note: Data transfer from a repository to Google Cloud in another location, between locations in Europe; the SKU is sold in every European region at one price, read in europe-west1. Within one location it is free.

filters.description: Artifact Registry Network Inter Region Egress Europe to Europe

gcp.artifactregistry.transfer.interconti.note: Data transfer from a repository to Google Cloud in another location, between continents, excluding Oceania. Within one location it is free.

filters.description: Artifact Registry Network Inter Region Egress Intercontinental \(Excl Oceania\)

gcp.artifactregistry.transfer.north_amer.note: Data transfer from a repository to Google Cloud in another location, between locations in North America; the SKU is sold in every North American region at one price, read in us-central1. Within one location it is free.

filters.description: Artifact Registry Network Inter Region Egress North America to North America

gcp.artifactregistry.transfer.oceania.note: Data transfer from a repository to Google Cloud in another location, to or from Oceania. Within one location it is free.

filters.description: Artifact Registry Network Inter Region Egress Intercontinental to/from Oceania
